## Checks

- [ ] This PR contains research evidence only.
- [ ] `bb inspect <bundle>` passes.
- [ ] The bundle contains no secrets, private paths, or unlicensed material.
- [ ] Failed steps and unresolved assumptions are preserved.
- [ ] The builder is not presented as its own verifier.
- [ ] No claim is upgraded by model agreement or repository acceptance.
- [ ] Imported proof-carrying theorems cite checked primary sources.
- [ ] Corrections use a descendant UUID rather than rewriting history.
